summary: Iteration 4 regression after removing npm 'overrides' block from frontend/package.json and switching Vercel install/build to yarn via vercel.json. Backend: 7/7 pytest regression tests pass (health, admin login, invalid login, /auth/me, bankrolls list, settings get, settings requires-auth). Frontend: login page renders at the actual configured preview URL (odds-tracker-178.preview.emergentagent.com — matches REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL in frontend/.env), admin login with admin@bettracker.pro/admin123 succeeds, redirects to Vezérlőpult (dashboard), 'Sikeres belépés' toast shown, bankroll 100 000 Ft rendered. No page errors, no JS errors from bundle. Only initial /auth/me returns 401 pre-login (expected).

integration_issues.issue: The alternate preview URL provided in review request (08cdf977-...preview.emergentagent.com) is a different origin than REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (odds-tracker-178.preview.emergentagent.com). Loading the app from the alternate host causes CORS block because backend uses allow_origins=['*'] together with allow_credentials=True, which browsers reject. This is a pre-existing config concern, NOT a regression from this iteration's package.json/vercel.json changes.

action_items: (Optional, pre-existing) In backend server.py CORS: since allow_credentials=True, set CORS_ORIGINS env to explicit origin list (both preview hosts + production) instead of '*', OR set allow_credentials=False if wildcard is intended. Currently harmless because frontend only calls its own configured REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, but blocks cross-host preview testing.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py:897-898 — CORSMiddleware uses allow_credentials=True with default allow_origins='*'. Browsers reject this combination for credentialed requests. Should be an explicit origin whitelist.
frontend/.env pins REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL to a single preview host; changing the preview host name (as the reviewer did) breaks the app until .env is updated. Not a bug per se, worth noting.
context_for_next_testing_agent: No regression from removing npm 'overrides' and adding yarn install/build in vercel.json. Local dev unaffected. Vercel build cannot be verified here — requires push+deploy. When testing frontend, ALWAYS use the URL matching frontend/.env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (currently odds-tracker-178.preview.emergentagent.com), not any alternate preview hostname, otherwise CORS wildcard+credentials blocks login.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional regression. The main-agent-supplied preview URL (08cdf977-...) differs from the frontend's compiled REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, so the browser correctly blocks the credentialed cross-origin request against a wildcard CORS policy. Testing at the URL matching REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL confirms the full login flow works end-to-end.
